description: A newline inside an item of an object constructor in an interpolation still ends the item
notes: The grammar lists Newline as a separator between object elements, but the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, so the newline is ignored and the input is valid, although the spec also describes a quoted template as a single-line expression. hashicorp/hcl makes newlines significant inside object constructors and ends the element at the newline (parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(true)), even inside an interpolation that ignores newlines, and the next line, which starts with ., can't start another element.
reference_error: Expected the start of an expression, but found an invalid expression token
